title: PEACE Act
committees: S-Foreign Relations Committee: Referred To 2026-06-09 || H-Foreign Affairs Committee: Referred To 2025-11-25 -> Markup By 2025-12-03
latest_action: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations.
summary: Protecting Europe from Antisemitic Crime and Extremism Act or the PEACE Act This bill requires the Department of State to periodically brief Congress over the next three years on (1) the threat of antisemitism and acts of international terrorism in Europe; and (2) diplomatic engagements with certain governments on transatlantic cooperative efforts to counter antisemitism and acts of international terrorism that may threaten transatlantic stability, the safety and security of U.S. citizens, and institutions abroad.

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
